meta.description:
One series, three mysteries! Enjoy an adventurous ride with the stories of a serial killer, a mechanic, and a gambler

Returning Series · First aired 9 Aug 2019 · India · Language: Bengali
Studio: Hoichoi · Network: hoichoi

Not complete. On your server: S1 5/5 | S2 1/6 (missing E2-6) | S3 6/6

videos.title: Jhontu Motors Part 1
videos.overview: Arjun wants some easy money to purchase his dream bike, when he gets an unbelievable offer from a local garage mechanic Jhontu. But will he accept the proposal?

videos.title: Jhontu Motors Part 2
videos.overview: Arjun is busy enjoying his life after taking help from Jhontu. But, has Jhontu forgotten him, or will he make Arjun pay?

videos.title: Shokuni Part 1
videos.overview: Saikat, the best gambler in town, participates in a high-stake tournament with Trilok Chakra Samity. Will he win again, or lose for the very first time?

videos.title: Shokuni Part 2
videos.overview: After the first game ended in an unexpected way, Saikat decides to go back for one last game. Will he make it out alive?

videos.title: Jhorer Raat
videos.overview: A serial killer escapes from an asylum on a stormy night. Will he find his target before the police catch him?

videos.title: Jhontu Motors: Origin - Part 1
videos.overview: The life and reality of the owner of the hub of crimes, Jhontu Motors, is more than what meets the eye. How did he become a part of this dark world?

videos.title: Homecoming
videos.overview: Truths about Kalo Nekre's past are revealed. Kalo Nekre meets Amrita, a tenant in her house, with an aura of mystery around her.

videos.title: Code Name Kalo Nekre
videos.overview: Amrita is kidnapped. Together with a weird private investigator- Mora, Sreyashi starts looking for her as she adapts her persona of Kalo Nekre.

videos.title: Dead Man Walking
videos.overview: Kalo Nekre uncovers a dark truth. Mora joins Trilok Chakra Samiti to play a dangerous game.

videos.title: The Locked Room Murder
videos.overview: Mora starts investigating an impossible murder as challenged by the Nameless. He has one hour in hand until he would be severely punished.

videos.title: Shokuni Level 2 Part 1
videos.overview: Shakuni goes behind the bars in the Nameless' prison. He has six days to get out.

videos.title: Shokuni Level 2 Part 2
videos.overview: Shakuni's attempts at jailbreak fails. What awaits him as he loses all hope?
